evidence: Cic. Rab. Perd. 5: ab Jove … pācem ac veniam petō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Favour, and so pardon: veniam dare, to forgive; veniam petere, to ask forgiveness; veniam impetrāre, to obtain it (Traupman).
The forgiveness of sins in the Vulgate and the Creed.

phrases.latin: ōrō ut imprūdentiae dēs prīmum veniam
phrases.english: first, please forgive my blundering in

phrases.latin: hoc argūmentum veniam eī darī docet quī cāsū peccat
phrases.english: this story teaches that forgiveness is given to the one who does wrong by accident

phrases.latin: Poenitentiam, inquit, agite, et baptīzētur ūnusquisque vestrum in nōmine Jēsū Chrīstī in remissiōnem peccātōrum vestrōrum
phrases.english: Repent, he said, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of your sins

sources: Lewis & Short: venia · Lewis & Short: remissio
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 196, 356.
